summary.text: Irene Gifford is a Republican member of the Maine House of Representatives for District 28 and is a candidate for re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Gifford has represented District 28 since 2022 and lives in Lincoln.

paragraphs.text: Irene Gifford lives in Lincoln, Maine, and Ballotpedia lists her career experience as working as a hairdresser.
Gifford won District 28 in 2022, succeeding Christopher Caiazzo, and won re-election in 2024, defeating Natalie DiPentino both times.
Ballotpedia lists her 2025-2026 committee assignment as the House Engrossed Bills Committee.
Gordon Street is the Democratic candidate against her in 2026.
